title: fm-sim catalog
description: Output of `ros2 run fm_sim_bringup catalog --json`. Each entry is one registered catalog yaml plus the package that registered it; the definitions also validate each yaml on its own.

share_file.description: A file in a package's install share directory.

relative_path.description: A path relative to a package share: no leading slash, no '..' segment.

frame_name.description: A name that becomes an MJCF body, a marker or a frame.

range.description: [low, high] with low <= high (checked on load).

pose.description: A pose in the world frame: position (m) and fixed-axis roll, pitch, yaw (rad).

package.description: The package that registered the entry.

available.description: False for a listed placeholder that run.launch.py refuses. The loader also sets it false while a requires_packages package is not installed.

requires_packages.description: Optional packages the entry needs installed, such as a description that ships only in a private image. While any is missing the entry is listed with available false and missing_packages, and run.launch.py refuses it.

missing_packages.description: Set by the loader, never in an entry yaml: the requires_packages that are not installed.

launch_args.description: Optional extra arguments for the backend launch.

description_args.description: xacro args this backend adds to the robot description; {mjcf_path} and {controllers_file} are filled in.

supported_backends.description: Backends this robot is known to run on; run.launch.py refuses the others.

mjcf.description: fm_sim_models registry key of the MuJoCo model.

mjcf_mount_xyz.description: Where the MJCF model's origin sits in the description's root frame. The MuJoCo generator mounts the model there, so the MuJoCo world and the description's world coincide. Default [0, 0, 0].

mesh_roots.description: Mesh URI prefixes the robot's URDF uses that no package resolves (a path relative to the URDF file, a package:// name no package has), each mapped to the share directory it means. A resolved mesh must stay under its directory.

cameras_file.description: Optional cameras file: per role (chest, wrist_right), the optical frame, rate_hz and real intrinsics, checked by fm_sim_cameras.cameras_file; each backend also refuses what it cannot render. Absent renders no cameras.

controller_roles.description: Controller names by role. broadcasters always start active; a controller entry activates other roles, and the rest load inactive.

launch_roles.description: Optional nodes a controller entry activates by role, such as MoveIt Servo. run.launch.py activates each role's requires, then includes its launch with launch_args and the run's robot_description once the active spawner has exited cleanly. A name may not also be a controller role.

requires.description: Controller roles that must be active before the launch starts.

robot_profile.description: Robot profile the controllers read joint, controller and frame names from; null for a robot no profile describes yet, which refuses a controller with a launch.

objects.description: Objects in the scene. Object and region names are unique (checked on load).

size.description: box: full x, y, z extents; cylinder: radius, height; sphere: radius (m).

static.description: Fixed to the world: no free joint, never respawned. Default false.

spawn.description: Seeded uniform offsets added to pose at every spawn (m, and rad for yaw). Not for a static object.

region.description: A box volume in the world frame, drawn as a marker; never a body in the sim.

success.description: object_in_region: the object's origin stays inside the region, grown by tolerance on every side, for hold_s seconds, and with max_speed set moves no faster than it; the episode fails at timeout_s.

max_speed.description: m/s; optional: the hold also needs the object this slow, so a held object being lowered does not count

control_descriptor.description: A controller's pipeline: its blocks and the edges between them. The controller's launch publishes the same file latched on /control/descriptor. Block ids are unique and every edge names one (checked on load).

control_block.description: One stage of the pipeline. variant says what implements it; live is a topic whose rate shows the block running; sim replaces either in sim, which marks the block a sim stand-in. A state_machine block lists its states and where the current one is read.

source.description: A field of a message on a topic; field is a dotted path, such as feedback.phase.

activate.description: Robot roles this controller needs active: controller_roles names or launch_roles names.

launch.description: Launch file run.launch.py includes, or null for none.

family.description: Optional group for variants of one controller, such as fm_skills for fm_skills_classical and fm_skills_learned. Absent means the entry is its own family.

control.description: Optional control.yaml that draws the controller's pipeline, shaped by control_descriptor.

control_descriptor.description: Set by the loader, which refuses it in an entry yaml: the parsed control file, named like the entry.
